ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/grey) localized clusters representing surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes with scattered high-contrast white linear streaks and circular spots distributed non-uniformly; higher density of light pixels observed near the lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 140 degrees; base of the notch is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys visible against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge sweep tapering to sharp, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered circular high-contrast spots located primarily on the terminal ends of both lobes and scattered across the mid-region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional linear white marks (rake marks) concentrated on the central and outer regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive light-colored linear rake marks and circular scarring across the entire visible dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, multi-tonal tip boundaries with concentrated white spotting.
